title: "The Coastal Western Screech-Owl Project"
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
source("R/page_helpers.R")
sections <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel("data/home_content.xlsx", sheet = "sections"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
news <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel("data/home_content.xlsx", sheet = "news"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
partners <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel("data/home_content.xlsx", sheet = "partners"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r banner, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show_banner("home", "The Coastal Western Screech-Owl Project")
```

See the **Call Dictionary** tab for a reference guide to the different calls, with spectrograms, audio, and the context each one was heard in.

```{r sections, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sections))) {
  row <- sections[i, ]
  featured <- identical(trimws(row$heading), "Our Goal")
  div_class <- if (featured) "home-section home-section-featured" else "home-section"
  cat('<div class="', div_class, '">\n', sep = "")
  if (!featured) cat('<h2>', htmltools::htmlEscape(trimws(row$heading)), '</h2>\n', sep = "")
  cat('<p>', italicize_binomials(htmltools::htmlEscape(row$body)), '</p>\n', sep = "")
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r news, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(news) > 0) {
  news <- news[order(news$date, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  cat('<h2>News &amp; Updates</h2>\n')
  cat('<div class="news-list">\n')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(news))) {
    row <- news[i, ]
    has_url <- !is.null(row$url) && !is.na(row$url) && nchar(trimws(row$url)) > 0
    cat('<div class="news-item">\n')
    cat('<span class="news-date">', htmltools::htmlEscape(format(row$date)), '</span>\n', sep = "")
    if (has_url) {
      cat('<span class="news-update"><a href="', htmltools::htmlEscape(row$url),
          '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">', htmltools::htmlEscape(row$update), '</a></span>\n', sep = "")
    } else {
      cat('<span class="news-update">', htmltools::htmlEscape(row$update), '</span>\n', sep = "")
    }
    cat('</div>\n')
  }
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r partners, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(partners) > 0) {
  cat('<h2>Partners</h2>\n')
  cat('<div class="partners-row">\n')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(partners))) {
    row <- partners[i, ]
    partner_item(row$name, logo = row$logo, url = row$url)
  }
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```
